title: Define the state
prompt: For House Robber (rob non-adjacent houses, maximize loot), the right meaning for `dp[i]` is…
options: The maximum loot obtainable from houses 0..i (whether or not house i itself is robbed)
The number of ways to rob i houses
explanation: With that meaning, the recurrence reads itself: either skip house i (dp[i-1]) or rob it, which forbids i-1 (dp[i-2] + nums[i]). Take the max.

title: Drill: space-optimized DP
prompt: From memory: tribonacci — T(0)=0, T(1)=1, T(2)=1, then T(n) = T(n-1)+T(n-2)+T(n-3). Return T(n) using THREE rolling variables, no array. (n ≤ 37, fits in int.)

solution.explanation: The roll: compute, then shift every variable one slot left. Bases handled before the loop.

hints: Roll: `a = b; b = c; c = cur;` — order matters.

title: Drill: max non-adjacent sum
prompt: From memory (rolling dp): return the maximum sum of elements of `nums` with no two chosen elements adjacent. `dp = max(skip, take)` with two rolling variables.
hints: `cur = max(prev1 (skip), prev2 + x (take))`, then roll the variables.
